questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure, over how many cooldowns, and how many showed the e/4 period?
If other devices or cooldowns were measured, why were they set aside?
Which gate, side-gate, displacement-field and magnetic-field ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown? Did you look for oscillations at ν = +1/2 and +5/2?
What does the second-best e/4 dataset look like at each even-denominator filling?
Besides the period values, what places the e/4 oscillations in the CD regime? Your numbers give ∆B1/∆B near 6.8, 3.1 and 7.6 for ν = −5/2, −1/2 and 3/2; how did you assign p ≈ 10, 2 and 6?
∆V1 comes from ν = −1 at 10 T. How much could the ADG lever arm change between that reference and the 14 T states, and should the 8% area allowance used for ∆B1/∆B also enter ∆V/∆V1?
Did you repeat fixed-field sweeps at the e/4 fillings, and do their 2D-FFTs show secondary peaks besides the line you select?
At ν = −1/2 in the doubled regime the field window holds less than one period (Fig. S9); did you measure a wider range there?
